parameter_set.description: PyBaMM 26.10.1.1's Prada2013 parameter set, for an LFP cell (Prada et al. 2013), with Chen2020's graphite OCP and exchange-current density. Exported to BPX by battinfo-records (scripts/export-pybamm-bpx.py).

notes: Parameter values from https://doi.org/10.1149/2.053304jes as implemented in PyBaMM's Prada2013 parameter set (PyBaMM 26.10.1.1, BSD-3-Clause), exported to BPX by battinfo-records.
Matches PyBaMM 26.10.1.1's native set within 0.56 mV RMS and 0.006% capacity (DFN discharges from 0.05C to 2C, and at 1C 20 K warmer).
The cell surface area and volume are not in the PyBaMM set. They are derived from the electrode stack, and only thermal models use them.
